fields.statement: QA with a scratch build in a hermetic repo: RHIZA_TEST_TMP_FREE_BYTES under rhiza.daemon.minTmpFree made daemon --once skip the ready change set as tmp-low naming free space and minimum, saved tmp_low in the daemon state, wrote a queue-wait line and one tmp-low inbox item; at the minimum, with 0, or with --min-tmp-free lowered it started; banana and 2Q refused as not a size

QA with a scratch build and a fake agent: a saved memory-low hold made rhiza run spawn journal one spawn-held entry with role verifier and the reading and limit, start no child until a daemon poll cleared it, then the child started and passed (held true); with no hold, no spawn-held entry and held false

QA with a scratch build: saved tmp-low, memory-low and disk-low holds held a foreground run's fresh step session with one parentless spawn-held entry per wait and no agent started; the session started once the hold cleared and the run succeeded

QA with a scratch build: held step sessions and a held verifier spawn of a live run each showed one spawn-held item in rhiza inbox and --json with change set, step, role and the hold's reading and limit, stable ID; gone after release and run end. Minor: rhiza inbox open on the item says no inbox item
